quest.6000000000000002.quest_subtitle: &7Conquer the brass dungeon of the Sun Spirit.&r
quest.6000000000000002.quest_desc: &7High in the Aether, the &eBronze Dungeon&7 hangs in the sky — a fortress of &6brass&7 and &ecarved stone&7 guarded by the &cSun Spirit&7.
&eHow to enter:&7 find the locked dungeon, defeat the lower bosses (Slider, Valkyrie Queen) to obtain the keys, then break the central seal.
&eInside you will face:&7 the &6Sun Spirit&7, a flame-wreathed boss vulnerable only to &bIce Crystals&7.
&aReward:&7 Sun Spirit Trophy, Phoenix Bow, and a permanent day-night cycle reset for the Aether.
